name: Steps / Deployment Pipeline
description: Deployment Pipeline product scenario for the Steps component.

items.label: Verify
items.content: Health checks will confirm the release.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Ordered step definitions. An omitted or empty list renders no navigation.

controls.name: step
controls.description: Controlled nonnegative integer index; displayed within the current item bounds.

controls.name: defaultStep
controls.description: Initial uncontrolled index; later changes are ignored. Defaults to 0.

controls.name: linear
controls.description: Allow only the current, earlier or immediately next step. Does not validate forms.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable step navigation; the visible panel remains usable.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Membrane spacing around each step control. Defaults to true.
